name: The Deadly Alliance springs its first obstacle attack
description: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance presents Shao Kahn as the first obstacle and narrates Quan Chi and Shang Tsung springing a false-allegiance attack. Later Deception evidence establishes that Shao Kahn had created a clone to draw enemies while he escaped. This Event therefore records the sourced attack occurrence without encoding the attacked figure as the real Shao Kahn or promoting the scene into a confirmed Shao Kahn death.
